topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This opening framing introduces the lecture aims, practical connections, and key learning outcomes.

topics.label: Viral origins of oncogenes and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: They trace the historical discovery of oncogenes through tumor virology and the laboratory assays used to measure cellular transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes, tumor suppressors, and mutation mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: They explore the functional classifications, regulatory pathways, and allele dosage effects of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes.

topics.label: Mechanisms and phenotypes of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: They describe the distinct forms of genomic instability along with the DNA repair and mitotic failures that cause them.

topics.label: Multi-step progression and hereditary cancer predispositions
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how the stepwise accumulation of somatic and inherited mutations drives cancer development and progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: This closing framing concludes the session, offers reading recommendations, and looks ahead to the next lecture.
